# Learnwise

> Learnwise is a multimodal learning platform for courses, source-grounded AI assistance, voice questions, practice, and personalized progress.

## Product

- [Home](https://learnwise.ai/): Product overview and learning workflow.
- [Features](https://learnwise.ai/features): Learning materials, AI assistant, practice, voice, and progress.
- [How it works](https://learnwise.ai/how-it-works): Learnwise learning loop.
- [For educators](https://learnwise.ai/educators): Educator and course workflows.

## Policies and help

- [Frequently asked questions](https://learnwise.ai/faq)
- [Contact](https://learnwise.ai/contact)
- [Privacy](https://learnwise.ai/privacy)
- [Terms](https://learnwise.ai/terms)

## Product capabilities

- Upload PDFs, DOCX files, and audio course materials.
- Ask an AI learning companion for explanations grounded in selected sources.
- Generate quizzes, exercises, and study resources from learning materials.
- Submit voice questions and review their transcriptions.
- Track learning paths, activity, progress, performance, and achievements.
- Provide educators with course-material management and learning analytics.
